latest_release.body:
This release fixes a mistake in our build that affected Netty 4.2.20 and 4.1.140, where we accidentally increased the glibc version to 2.33 for x86_64 and aarch64.
In this release the glibc version requirements return to their previous versions.

## What's Changed
* Stop decoding in Bzip2Decoder after an error by @yawkat in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18259
* Only mirror 127.0.0.1 to the IPv6 loopback in DnsQueryContextManager by @tsegismont in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18263
* NIO: Correctly catch all exceptions when NioDatagramChannel.block(...) fails by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18234
* Close channels that are still registered when an IoEventLoop exits on shutdown by @AbhishekShukla1289 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18035
* Do not set SO_REUSEADDR on the UDP socket of TestDnsServer by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18270
* IoUring: Fall back to buffered writes for non-FileChannelImpl channels by @dreamlike-ocean in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18229
* Upgrade lz4-java to 1.13.0 by @yawkat in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18264
* Include TrustManager / KeyManager instances in TLS session id context computations by @chrisvest in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18256
* Honour qvalues when HttpContentCompressor selects the content encoding by @allthingssecurity in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17726
* Use HTTP dates in ReadOnlyHttp2Headers.containsTimeMillis by @wozhenbang2004 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18271
* Avoid String.format in MacAddressUtil.formatAddress by @gsmet in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18172
* Initialize the hexadecimal tables of StringUtil lazily and cheaply by @gsmet in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18174
* Use the configured directory when creating disk attributes by @hellboy0621 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18297
* SslHandler: Stop wrapping when the transport can not keep up by @normanmaurer in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18253
* Add agent command to deduplicate private vulnerability reports by @chrisvest in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18299
* Encode the char after an unpaired high surrogate in writeUtf8(...) by @b84330808 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18252
* Close a QUIC stream reset by the remote peer once its output is ended by @vietj in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18313
* Use the real parameter names in argument-check messages by @Dhairya-007 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18309
* Quic: don't permanently consume stream ids when createStream(...) fails by @Echo009 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18311
* HTTP3: Reject invalid and connection-specific header fields by @Raghuvardhan-Reddy78 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18298
* Security improvement - allow MqttDecoder's maxBytesInMessage to be changed by @jbertram in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18125
* Discard input after a failed Socks5PrivateAuthRequestDecoder decode by @Raghuvardhan-Reddy78 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/17945
* Call `handshakeFailure` for failed TLS completion events by @gavinbunney in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18323
* Release the handshake response when a WebSocket extension is rejected by @lihanyu1715446406-afk in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18322
* Notify `LeakListener` for every detected leak by @gavinbunney in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18324
* Avoid redundant flush scheduling after draining NIO writes by @hellboy0621 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18296
* Get plain 'mvn compile' and 'test-compile' working by @chrisvest in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18300
* IoUring: Merge small buffers between large ones for SENDMSG_ZC by @dreamlike-ocean in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18250
* Check the range in ByteBuf.toString(index, length, charset) by @Marti2203 in https://github.com/netty/netty/pull/18156
* Fail the h2c upgrade stream for all header conver

# Netty Project

Netty is an asynchronous event-driven network application framework for rapid development of maintainable high performance protocol servers & clients.

## Links

* [Web Site](https://netty.io/)
* [Downloads](https://netty.io/downloads.html)
* [Documentation](https://netty.io/wiki/)
* [@netty_project](https://twitter.com/netty_project)
* [Official Discord server](https://discord.gg/q4aQ2XjaCa)
* [Modular Netty guide](testsuite-jpms/README.md)

## How to use

### System requirements

Netty 4.2 requires Java 8 or newer. The optional [`io_uring` native transport](./transport-native-io_uring/) requires Java 9 or newer.

### Usage with JDK 9+

You can read the [Modular Netty guide](testsuite-jpms/README.md) to learn more about using Netty with the Java Platform Module System, the guide 
contains a user section and a developer section for Netty contributors.

## How to build

For the detailed information about building and developing Netty, please visit [the developer guide](https://netty.io/wiki/developer-guide.html).  This page only gives very basic information.

You require the following to build Netty:

* Latest stable [OpenJDK 8](https://adoptium.net/)
  * Note that `io_uring` requires JDK 9
* Latest stable [Apache Maven](https://maven.apache.org/)
* If you are on Linux or MacOS, you need [additional development packages](https://netty.io/wiki/native-transports.html) installed on your system, because you'll build the native transport.

Note that this is build-time requirement.  JDK 5 (for 3.x) or 6 (for 4.0+ / 4.1+) is enough to run your Netty-based application.

### Branches to look

Development of all versions takes place in each branch whose name is identical to `<majorVersion>.<minorVersion>`.  For example, the development of 3.9 and 4.1 resides in [the branch '3.9'](https://github.com/netty/netty/tree/3.9) and [the branch '4.1'](https://github.com/netty/netty/tree/4.1) respectively.
